meta.title: Non-stick Pan Comparison: Teflon vs. Cast Iron vs. Our Place Titanium Pro
meta.description:
If you've been following along, you'll know that I've been working with LA-based company Our Place to produce the new Titanium Pro non-coated, non-stick pan. You can get it here: https://fromourplace.com/pages/j-kenji-lopez-alt

See a full detailed write-up of exactly how the NoCo nonstick technology works here: https://www.patreon.com/posts/145802110

It's a first of its kind technology that adds a a titanium oxide coating and embedded surface pattern to a non-stick surface that is metal utensil-safe and can be heated to 1,000°F. But, there is no such thing as a magic material, and every choice comes with some sort of trade-off. In this video I want to show you exactly how well the pan functions and where a different pan (like teflon-coated nonstick or cast iron may work better) so that you can make an informed decision about what suits your needs best.
